entryResolution.nullPolicy: null definition, unresolved caster, unresolved class context, or hard eligibility rejection returns 0

preflight: caster resource +0xBA must meet definition cost +0xBC
caster secondary resource +0x602 must meet definition requirement +0xF0
caster level +0x94 must meet definition requirement +0xBE
effect id 0xA3 invokes prerequisite helper 0x0043FDCC before the main effect loop

chanceAndMagnitude.successThreshold: caster field +0x604 plus definition field +0xC8, capped at 98 unless definition +0xC8 is at least 200; invocation/class state can force the successful path
chanceAndMagnitude.sharedMagnitude: definition ranges +0xC0..+0xC2 are combined with scaled caster data, then a bounded random value is selected
chanceAndMagnitude.perEffectValue: each effect uses definition +0xA8[index] when nonzero, otherwise the shared randomized magnitude

effectExecution.genericHelper: effects 162 and 178 can dispatch through 0x0043FC13 with selector 3
effectExecution.roomOutput: effect branches can prepare caster output and broadcast through 0x0046B010 before the shared join
effectExecution.semanticPolicy: numeric effects remain structurally named unless independently correlated to authoritative records

resourceAndFailureOrdering.success: subtract full definition cost +0xBC from caster +0xBA and full positive definition requirement +0xF0 from caster +0x602 before effect processing
resourceAndFailureOrdering.failedRoll: subtract full positive definition cost and one-half of signed definition requirement, then emit failure output and room broadcast
resourceAndFailureOrdering.hardRequirementFailure: emits the specific unmet resource, secondary-resource, or level response and returns handled without effect execution
resourceAndFailureOrdering.outputFlush: 0x0046B170 flushes caster-facing output; 0x0046B010 performs room-scoped broadcast

returnContract: returns 0 for hard preflight/null rejection and 1 for handled success, failed roll, or requirement-response paths
nextBoundary: correlate numeric effect handlers with room/action records, then move to Worldgroup scheduler and persistent DFA/save ownership paths
